Synopsis:
A player walked into Balthazar's chambers in the colony, while Balthazar is alive, and was spotted by him (or one of his undead). Balthazar reacts with hostility, but players can convince him that they have been turned into thralls.This can only happen if Balthazar is alive at this point and you didn't try the Audience with the Absolute. If you did not send Nightsong to Ketheric, Balthazar would have died in combat in her prison.This dialog will also play when interacting with Balthazar in this route.

Cluster Contexts:
- COL_Necromancer_EnterRoom.json: The party has pushed into the Mind Flayer colony and walked into Balthazar’s chamber after off‑screen fighting; companions are present and the area hums with the Absolute’s intrusive psychic presence. Balthazar is alive and is interrupted mid‑necromancy — he (or one of his undead sentries) notices the intruders and responds angrily, noting General Thorm didn’t warn him. If you reached this route without triggering the Audience with the Absolute (and Balthazar survived prior events), the player can pretend to be an enthralled thrall by staring vacantly; Balthazar will accept that explanation and assume the player’s mind has been “decluttered” and put to work. This exchange assumes a straightforward, non‑bard, non‑advantage attempt to pass as a thrall and is one of the short recognition/denial beats that play inside the colony approaching the Ketheric showdown.
- SHA_Necromancer_Chosen.json: The player meets Balthazar, the necromancer, in his temporary command centre in the Shar temple. They find him at an altar, repairing one of his damaged undead, while other minions bustle around. Balthazar has been sent by Ketheric Thorm to recover Nightsong, but has been unable to clear a path to her vault. He decides to recruit the player, upon recognising them as tadpoled. The player can agree or decline, and can possibly persuade him to loan his flesh golem to aid their exploration.
- SHA_NightsongPrison_NecroAndNightsong.json: If Balthazar is alive when the player reaches Nightsong, they will encounter a dialogue where Balthazar and Nightsong square off. The player has one last chance to betray Balthazar and prevent him from taking Nightsong to Moonrise.
- MOO_Executioner.json: Dialogue with Z'rell when she's upstairs. This takes place after the execution scene, and involves Z'rell mind-melding to see how players dealt with the goblins, and testing their 'desire' to be one with the Absolute via a second mind-meld. She then gives them the mission to aid Balthazar, giving them the key to his chamber, and instructing them to find evidence of where he can be found.
- SHA_Necromancer_Barricade.json: The player is challenged by some skeleton warriors at a barricade outside the Necromancer's lair. The necromancer speaks through the dead warriors - his words in their dessicated voices.(this mayor may not follow on from an earlier scene with more skeletons controlled by the necromancer). A mindmeld convinces the necromancer to command his skeletons to grant entry. The scene ends with combat with the skeletons, or a shadowquake triggering a fight between player (+ skeletons) against sharran wraiths. Afterwards, the player is invited into Balthazar's inner sanctum.

The player meets Balthazar, the necromancer, in his temporary command centre in the Shar temple. They find him at an altar, repairing one of his damaged undead, while other minions bustle around. Balthazar has been sent by Ketheric Thorm to recover Nightsong, but has been unable to clear a path to her vault. He decides to recruit the player, upon recognising them as tadpoled. The player can agree or decline, and can possibly persuade him to loan his flesh golem to aid their exploration.

If Balthazar is alive when the player reaches Nightsong, they will encounter a dialogue where Balthazar and Nightsong square off. The player has one last chance to betray Balthazar and prevent him from taking Nightsong to Moonrise.
